title: ModelInput
description: Structured replacement for the free-text user prompt in main.py: one story plus the characters who must speak.

characters.description: Exactly two characters: the speakers of the generated dialogue.

output_language.description: ISO 639-1 code (optionally with region) for the dialogue. Defaults to Spanish.

max_turns.description: Optional cap on the number of dialogue turns.

instruction.description: Optional extra direction for this run (tone, length, what to emphasise).
